lines.port: // Set from the moment DoNamingScreen allocates the screen until it is freed: the lower screen's keyboard takes its place, and the upper
// screen keeps the last frame it presented (a battle, the field, a dialogue) instead of showing FireRed's own keyboard while it loads, is up or
// fades out. A nickname after a catch has its own hold from the moment it is accepted (CtrBattle_NickHold); this one covers a gift, a trade and
// every other naming screen as well.
